same_build_ablation: Run v7 with route_search=false to isolate this algorithm from release packaging.

shared_limits.wall_seconds: inherit the same per-task manifest budget on both arms; do not flatten all tasks to 3600

must_match: task IDs and immutable task/image digests
CPU, memory, network, task wall time and adapter delivery reserve
fresh independent workspaces and empty task-local memory
existing v6 reliability features enabled on both arms
mechanism_outcomes: route proposals accepted/rejected and completed/incomplete episodes
trial tool cost, checkpoint/restore cost and model token cost
same-check baseline failure to candidate pass with actual target change
failed-route reuse avoided under matching conditions
context-aware repetition before and after intervention
execution_note: No paid task launched by preparation. Re-run both arms on the same selected tasks; do not compare a new v7 run only against the old v5 scores. Counterbalance arm order. Small samples are exploratory, not conclusive.
